design_philosophy.goal: Information clarity, functional beauty, and fast data entry for logistics operations.
rules: Every pixel must be utilized intelligently. Use 'Control Room' grid layout.
No full-screen gradients; texture and solid technical backgrounds over gloss.
Clear status indicators using high-contrast colors (amber, emerald, red).
Ensure fast readability for operations workers.

mobile.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-around items-center z-50 lg:hidden

desktop.classes: fixed top-0 left-0 w-64 h-screen bg-slate-900 border-r border-slate-800 hidden lg:flex flex-col z-50

components.metrics_card: Flat background (slate-900), 1px subtle border (slate-800), large primary metric text (text-3xl font-black), clear status icon, subtle hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) and border highlight.
components.data_table: Dense layout, border-collapse, subtle border-b on rows, distinct status badges.
components.forms: Use Shadcn inputs. Dark theme inputs with border-slate-800, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500, clear labels.
components.photo_upload: Dashed border area (border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 bg-slate-950/50), central upload icon, preview grid for selected photos.

login_background.description: A dark, narrow warehouse aisle with shelves filled with boxes and goods, illuminated by overhead lights.
login_background.usage: Use as a full-cover background image on the login page with a heavy dark overlay (bg-slate-950/80) to ensure login form readability.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI primitives.
Ensure the app is fully responsive. Mobile view should prioritize the bottom navigation bar and stack dashboard cards. Desktop view uses a fixed left sidebar.
Install and import 'lucide-react' for all icons (Dashboard, Plus/New, History, User/Profile, Upload, Export, etc.).
Use Google Fonts 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Update index.html or global css to import these.
The login page should feature the provided warehouse image as a background with a heavy slate-950 overlay.
Dashboard should have 4 metric cards (Total Remessas, Pendentes, Resolvidas, Vencidas) mapping to the defined status colors.
The 'Nova Custódia' form should handle basic text inputs and have dedicated sections for uploading 'Etiqueta', 'Caixa', and 'Adicional' photos.
Implement the layout wrappers to handle the space required for the mobile bottom nav (pb-20) and desktop sidebar (lg:pl-64).
DO NOT use Inter or generic sans-serif for headings.
Always apply 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and significant UI elements for testing.
